official_definition: {During Seal} Pyro Drive - (When Attacks) Destroy any number of opposing Spirits/Ultimates with a BP equal or inferior to this Spirit's up to the number of "God-King"/"Ten Crown" family Spirits you control, and you can target attack an opposing Spirit/Ultimate. When you've done so, at the end of a blocked battle, for each Spirit/Ultimate destroyed in this battle, send one opposing Life to the Reserve.

ownership_rules.native_syntax: Ability block header contains [Pyro Drive] or [Pyro Drive: Param]
ownership_rules.prose_exclusion: Mentions inside body clauses ("with [Pyro Drive]", "give [Pyro Drive]") classified as REFERENCES or GRANTED, never NATIVE.

resolution.description: Mutates game state as specified by official effect text.
